set -eu

#!/bin/sh
set -eu
for image in /var/lib/data-lvm/pv1.img /var/lib/data-lvm/pv2.img; do
    device=$(losetup -j "$image" | sed -n '1s/:.*//p')
    if [ -z "$device" ]; then
        device=$(losetup --find --show "$image")
    fi
    lvmdevices --adddev "$device" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
done
pvscan --cache
vgchange -ay vg_data
ANTRIEB_SCRIPT
chmod 0755 /usr/local/sbin/prepare-data-lvm

[Service]

[Install]
